episodes.title: The Transfer
episodes.hook: He Got Himself Locked Up to Save His Brother
episodes.summary: In seven days, Bruno gets moved to Max, the prison nobody comes back from. So his brother Ken, an orangutan who plans everything, gets himself locked up in the same block to get him out.

transcript.text: In seven days, they move my brother to a place nobody comes back from.
So I made sure they transferred me in with him.
Every wall. Every guard. Every blind spot.
I know this place better than the people who built it.
New guy.
Nobody transfers into B Block on purpose.
I'm not staying long.
They say my brother stole the warden's keys.
He didn't.
Get some sleep, new guy.
Bruno's got seven whole days.
...I never told you his name.

episodes.title: The Keys
episodes.hook: His Bunk Was Empty. The Door Was Still Locked.
episodes.summary: At three in the morning the raccoon's bunk is empty, and the cell door is still locked. He isn't breaking out. He's going somewhere, and coming back. Ken follows the air shaft to find out where.

transcript.text: Three A.M. His bunk was empty.
And the door was still locked.
He wasn't breaking out.
He was going somewhere. And coming back.
The vent behind his bunk leads to an old air shaft. Straight up to the roof.
Psst. New guy. You're looking at the vent.
You notice a lot.
Six years in here. I'm Marco.
Don't. The last guy who asked about the raccoon ended up in the hole.
Then I won't ask.
...You're gonna ask.
Where do you go at night?
Out.
Take me with you.
Why would I do that?
You know who framed my brother. I can get you out. For good.
You have no idea what you're asking.
The one who framed your brother...
...runs this prison.

episodes.title: The Warden
episodes.hook: The Warden Knows About His Brother
episodes.summary: Day three. The warden sends for Ken. Nobody asks for B Block, and Ken's brother goes to Max in five days. Ken says he doesn't have a brother. The warden doesn't believe a word of it, and Ken finds out where the master keys are kept.

transcript.text: Day three. The warden sent for me.
Right on schedule.
Sit down, Ken.
You asked for B Block.
Nobody asks for B Block.
I like the quiet.
Your brother goes to Max in five days.
Nothing you do changes that.
...I don't have a brother.
Of course you don't.
Well? How'd it go?
He's scared.
Hollis? Of what?
His desk. Third drawer.
He checked it twice while we talked.
Nobody stole the warden's keys.
He still has them.
You want me in the warden's office.
No.
Tell me how you get out. Every night.

episodes.title: The Third Drawer
episodes.hook: Every Night He Leaves. Every Morning He's Back.
episodes.summary: Ken finally sees how the raccoon gets out at night: through the vent, up the old air shaft, to a roof hatch that only opens from the outside. So who opens it for him?

transcript.text: He didn't answer. He washed his paws.
Get some sleep, new guy.
The shaft ends at a hatch. It only opens from outside.
Who opens the roof?
I don't break out, new guy.
I get let out.
Every night?
When there's work.
That hatch takes a master key.
Out of his drawer at two. Back before six.
That's why he checks it. Twice.
Then one morning, they won't be there.
He'd report them stolen.
...He can't report them stolen twice.
Forty-oh-oh-nine. To my office.
What does our new guest want?
...Out.

episodes.title: Bruno
episodes.hook: His Brother Doesn't Want to Be Saved
episodes.summary: Marco gets Ken ten minutes with his brother in the laundry. Bruno has seen something at night in the warden's wing. Bruno tells Ken to go home. Ken isn't leaving without him.

transcript.text: How's Hollis?
...Fine.
I got you ten minutes. Laundry.
You're gonna ask your brother to run.
He'll come.
Go home, Ken.
Not without you.
I mopped the warden's wing. At night.
He opened the roof. For a raccoon.
Then he saw me.
Two days later, they searched my bunk.
I didn't take the keys.
If I run, I did.
He writes it all in a book.
Third drawer. Under the keys.
...Then I get the book.
Forty-oh-fifty-eight. Remain where you are.
Go home, Ken.
...The hole.

episodes.title: The Count
episodes.hook: Back Before the Six O'Clock Count, or It's Over
episodes.summary: Bruno is in the hole, and Ken needs the roof. He has until the six o'clock count to get up there and back down, and the guards are already coming down the corridor.

transcript.text: Last time, the warden threw my brother in the hole.
In three days, they move him somewhere I can't reach.
To save him, I need the raccoon's way out. The roof.
Six A.M. is the headcount.
If your bed is empty, you go in the hole too.
I'll be back before six.
I start in the kitchen at five-thirty. Just saying.
At two A.M., the raccoon went into the vent. I followed.
The warden was waiting on the roof with his keys.
He let the raccoon out. They walked off together.
From the roof, I could see the whole way out.
Before I could get back, the warden locked the hatch.
...With me still on the roof.
Fifteen minutes until the headcount.
If my bed was empty, I'd never see Bruno again.
Then I remembered Marco. The kitchen was right below me.
Ken! Down the vent! Hurry!
Go, go! They're already counting!
I got back to my bed with one minute left.
You left your journal on your bed, new guy.
"The raccoon planted the key that framed Bruno."
...You knew. The whole time.

episodes.title: The Frame
episodes.hook: Working With the One Who Framed His Brother
episodes.summary: The raccoon has read Ken's journal, and now he knows that Ken knew all along. He says the frame was the warden's orders. Can Ken still work with the one who put his brother here?

transcript.text: Last time, the raccoon found my journal.
It said he planted the key that framed my brother.
So you knew the whole time.
Before I ever walked in here.
Then you know how I knew his name.
The warden told me who to frame.
One night, your brother saw the warden let me out.
So the warden had me hide a key under his bunk.
And the day I arrived, you told him I want out.
He asked. I answered.
I should hate you.
But you know how to get over the wall. I don't.
So here's the deal. I get all of you out.
But I go first.
The roof hatch needs the warden's keys. I'll take them.
And his book. It proves Bruno is innocent.
...Deal.
Change of plans, Ken.
Your brother leaves tomorrow night.
Sleep well.
Tomorrow night. And we still don't have the keys.

episodes.title: The Office
episodes.hook: The Van Comes Tonight. The Keys Are in the Warden's Desk.
episodes.summary: Transfer day. The van to Max comes at eleven, and the roof only opens at two. Ken's plan is dead unless he gets the warden's keys out of the third drawer today.

transcript.text: Last time, the warden moved my brother's transfer. It's tonight.
To get us out, I need his master keys. They're in his desk.
The warden never leaves his office, Ken.
He will. If the kitchen fills with smoke.
...You want me to burn the toast.
You're gonna get us both killed.
...Okay. I'm in.
Smoke! Everybody out! The kitchen's on fire!
Every guard ran to the kitchen. Even the warden.
Third drawer. The lock is old. Ten seconds.
The warden's book. He wrote everything down.
Every night he let the raccoon out.
And the day he hid a key under Bruno's bunk.
This proves my brother is innocent.
And under the book... the master keys.
I was back in line before the smoke cleared.
...Empty.
Search every cell in B Block. Now.

episodes.title: Lights Out
episodes.hook: The Keys Are Gone, and the Warden Tells No One
episodes.summary: The warden opens his drawer and finds it empty. He can't report the keys stolen twice, so he waits. Tonight Ken has to get Bruno out of the hole before the van comes.

transcript.text: Last time, I took the warden's keys and his book.
He found the drawer empty, and searched every cell.
They found nothing. Marco had hidden it all in the kitchen.
Under forty kilos of potatoes. Nobody checks the potatoes.
And the warden couldn't report the keys stolen.
He'd already told everyone they were stolen once.
At eleven, the van comes for Bruno.
We had thirty minutes.
First, the hole. One key, and my brother was out.
Then up the air shaft to the roof. All four of us.
Keys, Ken.
I go first. That was the deal.
He climbed out first.
Then he locked the hatch behind him.
Sorry, Ken. Only one of us gets out tonight.
...Hello, Knox.
...Nobody has called me that in years.

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.hook: Season Finale: Who Gets Over the Wall?
episodes.summary: The season one finale. Ken and the raccoon go back further than anyone knew, all the way to the old zoo. Tonight is the only night, and not everyone is getting over the wall.

transcript.text: Last time, the raccoon took the keys, went first...
...and locked us under the roof. So I said his real name.
How long have you known it was me, Ken?
Since the day I walked in, Knox.
Years ago, at the old zoo, we planned an escape together.
You got out. I got caught. You never came back for me.
So tonight, I'm the one leaving you behind.
I know. That's why I kept one key back.
The key to the door in the wall.
We don't need the roof. Down the shaft, through the hub, to the wall.
...You planned for me to betray you.
I planned for everything.
Bruno. Take the book to the police. It proves you're innocent.
Marco goes with you. Now.
Stop right there.
Go, Bruno. I'll hold him here.
Where is your brother, Ken?
...I don't have a brother.

episodes.title: The Night Guard
episodes.hook: No Broken Glass. No Alarm. The Diamond Is Gone.
episodes.summary: The Star of Borneo is gone from the city museum. No broken glass, no alarm, and a night guard who swears he never left his desk. Monty reads people. Sergeant Rex just wants him not to do the thing.

transcript.text: No broken glass. No alarm.
And the Star of Borneo is gone.
Don't do the thing.
I haven't done anything yet.
You're smiling. That's the thing.
I was here all night. I never left my desk.
Mud on your feet. Rain on your back.
You were outside for twenty minutes.
...Okay. Twenty minutes. But I didn't take it.
I know.
You know?
He's scared, not guilty. Someone knew exactly when he'd leave.
And they left this on the roof.
That's a raccoon print.
Not a raccoon.
The raccoon.
Impossible. He's locked up in B Block.
Then somebody's letting him out at night.

episodes.title: The Roof
episodes.hook: The Skylight Only Opens From the Inside
episodes.summary: The thief came in through the museum skylight. But that skylight only opens from the inside. Somebody let him in, and Monty wants to know who.

transcript.text: He came in through the skylight.
We're done here.
Then why is it locked?
This only opens from the inside.
Somebody let him in.
Bernie?
Bernie was outside, getting rained on.
Somebody else was waiting inside.
One more thing.
The state prison called.
The warden's master keys were stolen.
Last week.
A thief locked up in B Block...
...gets out at night...
...the week the warden's keys go missing.
Sergeant.
Nobody lost those keys.
Then who has them?
I'd like to visit a prison.
Absolutely not.

episodes.title: Visiting Hours
episodes.hook: The Prisoner Who Never Sees Visitors
episodes.summary: Monty goes to the state prison to see the raccoon in B Block. He has no badge and no visitor pass, and the raccoon never sees visitors. Monty says he'll see him.

transcript.text: I'm with the police.
He's with me.
He never sees visitors.
He'll see me.
All these years, and no badge.
Never wanted one.
He's never answered anyone.
...He answered me.
Wrong star?
He stole a fake.
Stones don't lose facets.
Who takes it out of its box?
Its case, Consultant.
Only I do. For cleaning.
The appraisal is tomorrow.
A fake can't survive an appraisal.
...Unless it gets stolen first.

episodes.title: The Latch
episodes.hook: He Knew Something Only the Thief Could Know
episodes.summary: Friday at the museum. The night guard says his break was moved. The alarm log shows the director's code. Monty has one question about the skylight latch, and one chance to find the real Star.

transcript.text: Last time, we found out the stolen Star was a fake.
Someone swapped the real diamond before the thief ever got there.
And only the director ever opens its case.
The insurance men check the Star today.
A fake won't pass. So the fake had to vanish first.
You can't prove a word of it, Consultant.
The thief came in through the skylight. Someone opened it from inside.
Tricky latch, though. It sticks in the rain.
Only if you push it to the left.
...I never said you'd touched it.
Only the one who opened it would know that.
...Fine. I swapped the Star for a fake.
Then I paid a thief to steal the fake.
You keep the diamond, and the insurance pays you for it.
Then where's the real Star?
Too famous to sell. It's still in this building.
The gift shop sells glass copies of the Star.
Glass is light. ...This one is heavy.
That's the real Star of Borneo.
One more thing. Who let the thief out of prison?
I only paid. Someone at that prison opens the door.
...Then that's who I want.

episodes.title: The Last Train
episodes.hook: Nobody Got On. Nobody Got Off. The Money Is Gone.
episodes.summary: A new case. On the night train, the payroll box is empty before the next stop. The doors stayed shut, so the thief is still on board, and Monty has twelve minutes.

transcript.text: Last time, the museum director confessed.
He said someone at the state prison lets the raccoon out.
The chief says the prison is off limits.
So. New case. Tonight.
...For now.
The night train. It carries the workers' pay.
Twelve minutes ago, the pay box was full. Now it's empty.
Nobody got on. Nobody got off.
I was at the front the whole time, officers.
I only came back when I heard the shouting.
The money bags were dusted with blue ink.
Whoever touched them has blue paws by now.
...He just looked at his paws.
There's no ink, sir.
But only the one who touched the bags would check.
Try the lost property box. Nobody ever looks there.
...It's all here.
Oh, and your watch, sir.
When did you take his watch?
Monty. Where did you learn to steal like that?
...Next stop, Sergeant.

episodes.title: The Confession
episodes.hook: He Confessed to a Crime He Didn't Commit
episodes.summary: A huge bison walks into the station and says he took the bakery van. Sergeant Rex is delighted. Monty says he didn't do it. So why would anyone confess?

transcript.text: Last time, you took a man's watch and he never felt it.
You still haven't told me where you learned that.
And I'm still not going to, Sergeant.
I took the milk van. Arrest me.
Great. Sign here.
No. He didn't.
The driver's seat is pushed all the way forward.
Look at him. He'd never fit behind that wheel.
Someone half his size drove it.
Someone waiting on the bench outside.
...He's my little brother. He's all I've got.
He only wanted to drive it once. He brought it back.
Your brother tried to take the blame for you.
Go and tell the milk man the truth. He'll listen.
The milk man got his van back. He's not pressing charges.
Still on the raccoon?
Someone at that prison opens his door. I'll find out who.
This came for you. No name on it.
"Little hands."
...Nobody has called me that in twenty years.
Monty? What is it?
...Nothing, Sergeant. Just a sweet.

episodes.title: The Clean Lift
episodes.hook: Eleven Wallets, One Hour, and Nobody Felt a Thing
episodes.summary: Eleven wallets gone from the old market in one hour, with a wrapped sweet left in every empty pocket. Monty knows exactly how it's done. Rex wants to know how he knows.

transcript.text: Last time, someone sent Monty a sweet. And a name: little hands.
He told me it was nothing.
...It was nothing.
The old market. Twelve pockets picked in one morning.
Nobody felt a thing. And in every pocket, the thief left a sweet.
It's the same sweet.
Whoever sent it wants me to come back here.
Come back? You've been here before?
...A long time ago.
Twelve pockets, and nobody felt a thing. That's called a clean lift.
Only a master can do that.
Do you know any masters?
...I used to.
Where were you this morning, Monty? You weren't at the station.
...I went for a walk.
That's him! The monkey! He was right by my stall this morning!
Right by his stall. On your walk.
I'd know those little hands anywhere.
...Monty. I have to take you in.
Turn around.

episodes.title: Little Hands
episodes.hook: Season Finale: The Detective's Secret Past
episodes.summary: The season one finale. Monty is on the wrong side of the interview table, somebody is framing him, and the truth about his past finally comes out.

transcript.text: Last time, a witness said Monty picked twelve pockets at the market.
And he called him little hands.
So why were you at that market, Monty?
Looking for whoever sent me that sweet.
Twenty years ago, I was the best pickpocket in that market.
A mandrill called the Tailor taught me. He called me little hands.
One day, a young police dog caught me.
...And I let you go.
That's why you never took a badge.
A badge means a background check.
They'd find out you let a thief go. You'd lose your job.
I was protecting you, Sergeant.
And I was protecting you.
While you sat in that cell, someone picked another pocket.
So it wasn't me. And the hands were smaller than mine.
A kid. Just like I was.
Welcome back, little hands.
I kept your old spot for you.
He got away. And he took the kid with him.
Then we find them. Together.

episodes.title: Struck
episodes.hook: Struck by Lightning, He Became the Fastest Giraffe Alive
episodes.summary: Gerald was just the tallest guy on the savanna. Agility: forty-eight. Then a lightning strike changed the proteins in his muscles, and now he runs faster than anything alive. The cheetah has noticed.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
To everyone else, I was just the tallest guy on the savanna.
Agility: forty-eight.
Then one night, the storm came.
And I was the tallest thing for miles.
The vet said the lightning changed the proteins in my muscles.
But the first time I ran, I didn't stop until the sun came up.
And I wasn't the only one who noticed.
Ninety-nine?
That's my number.

episodes.title: The Cheetah
episodes.hook: Nobody Had Ever Raced the Cheetah. Until Now.
episodes.summary: Nobody had ever beaten the cheetah. Nobody had ever even tried. Sunday, on the river plain, from the baobab to the water, Gerald finds out how fast he really is.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
The river plain. Sunday.
From the baobab to the water.
Nobody had ever beaten him.
Nobody had ever even tried.
Ninety-three kilometres an hour.
He's faster than me. Everybody knows that.
But nobody's ever asked how long he can keep it up.
So every morning at dawn, I ran. And ran.
He took the lead in two seconds.
At ten seconds, he was gone.
At twenty seconds...
I could hear him breathing.
Every morning at dawn, tall guy.
...I've seen enough.
Then he did something nobody's ever seen him do.

episodes.title: The Finish
episodes.hook: The Cheetah Did Something Nobody Had Ever Seen
episodes.summary: Race day. Twenty seconds in, the cheetah is fading and Gerald is closing. Then the cheetah does something nobody on the savanna has ever seen.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
At twenty-one seconds, I caught up.
And he stopped.
He wasn't hurt. He just walked off the course.
Go on, tall guy.
...You can't lose a race you don't finish.
Twenty seconds.
That's how long he can keep it up.
He'd watched me train. He'd seen enough.
I ran on alone. Twelve kilometres to the water.
The lightning changed the proteins in my muscles.
I didn't slow down once.
The records say there was no race.
I won the longest race of my life.
...And nobody timed it.
The next morning, I couldn't stand up.

episodes.title: The Vet
episodes.hook: The Fastest Giraffe Alive Can't Stand Up
episodes.summary: The morning after the race, Gerald can't get up. Doc the tortoise explains what the lightning really did to his muscles, and how long he can keep it up.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
Doc... what's wrong with my legs?
The lightning changed the proteins in your muscles.
Now they burn fuel three times faster.
How long can I keep it up?
Rest first. Then we count.
Five minutes. I felt fine.
At nine, my legs started to shake.
Then they gave out.
Ten minutes flat out.
Go past it... and they may not come back.
You don't have to be the fastest.
You have to be careful.
A hundred metres.
Sunday, tall guy.

episodes.title: The Sprint
episodes.hook: A Hundred Metres Against the Cheetah
episodes.summary: The cheetah wants a rematch: a hundred metres, his kind of race. Doc says don't. Gerald runs anyway.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
Last time, Doc found my limit. Ten minutes flat out.
Then the cheetah challenged me. A hundred metres.
Don't race him, Gerald. A hundred metres is his race.
The lightning changed your muscles. Not your size.
You weigh as much as a car. You need time to get going.
The records say our last race never happened.
I want a real one.
Ready, tall guy?
He was gone before my second step.
I caught up fast. Just not fast enough.
He won by a whole body length.
Short races are mine, tall guy.
Long ones... might be yours.
That's when we saw the smoke.
Dry lightning. The grass is on fire.
No rain for weeks. If the wind turns, it comes here.

episodes.title: Dry Season
episodes.hook: The Fire Gets Closer Every Morning
episodes.summary: The river is dry and there's smoke on the horizon every morning. Sixty kilometres, then forty, then thirty. Gerald trains with Doc to last longer than ten minutes before the fire comes.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
Last time, I lost the race. Then we saw smoke.
Lightning had set the dry grass on fire, far away.
Every morning, the smoke was a little closer.
The river is almost dry. The grass is like paper.
If that fire reaches the plain, the herd can't outrun it.
Then I have to last longer than ten minutes.
The lightning made your muscles burn fuel fast. I can't change that.
But we can train them to last longer.
Every dawn, Doc timed me. Ten minutes. Then eleven.
And every dawn, the cheetah watched.
He never said a word.
Then, on the fourth night, the wind turned.
Gerald. The fire is nine kilometres away.
And the herd is on the wrong side of the river.

episodes.title: The Fire
episodes.hook: The Fire Is Coming. The Herd Can't Outrun It.
episodes.summary: That night the fire comes. From up at his height, Gerald sees it first. The herd can't outrun it, so he has to get everyone across the water, and he only has ten minutes.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
Last time, the wind turned. The fire was nine kilometres away.
And the herd was on the wrong side of the river.
The only shallow crossing is three kilometres downstream.
They'll never find it in the smoke. Somebody has to lead them.
I'm the tallest animal out here. I can see over the smoke.
They can follow me.
So I ran. Back and forth, pushing them toward the water.
Then something shot past me in the dark.
You're too slow on the turns, tall guy.
I'll catch the stragglers. You keep them moving.
One by one, they crossed.
Then my legs started to shake.
Gerald! That's ten minutes! Stop!
But two of them were still on the far side.
...And the fire was already there.

episodes.title: Ninety-Nine
episodes.hook: Season Finale: Is He Still the Fastest Giraffe Alive?
episodes.summary: The season one finale. Gerald's legs are going, and two animals are still on the wrong side of the river. Then someone nobody expected comes back.

transcript.text: My name is Gerald.
And I am the fastest giraffe alive.
Last time, I ran flat out for ten minutes. My limit.
And two of the herd were still on the far side.
Gerald. Go past ten minutes, and your legs may never be the same.
I know, Doc. I'm going anyway.
I went back across the water, into the smoke.
I found them. A mother and her little one.
Halfway back, my legs gave out.
Then the cheetah came back. For me.
Get up, tall guy. I'll push them. You just walk.
By sunrise, every single one of them was across.
Ninety-nine, Gerald.
...It's your number.
Your agility dropped to ninety-four. Running past your limit cost you.
...It was worth it.
